notes: EvidenceRecord contract · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESIGN ONLY · no runtime · no mutation. One EvidenceRecord = one deterministic measurement of one dimension of one candidate for one Work Order.

required_fields.name: evidence_id
required_fields.notes: monotonic · never reused · founder-audit surface

required_fields.name: schema_version
required_fields.notes: must match a shipped schema · else NOT_MEASURED

required_fields.name: project_id
required_fields.notes: scope of measurement

required_fields.name: work_order_id
required_fields.notes: links every measurement to its triggering order

required_fields.name: candidate_id
required_fields.notes: identifies WHICH candidate the measurement is against

required_fields.name: evidence_type
required_fields.shape: enum · see evidence-bundle-schema · e.g. COMPILATION · TYPE_CHECK · TESTS · REGRESSION · STATIC_ANALYSIS · AST · DEPENDENCY_GRAPH · CYCLES · COMPLEXITY · DUPLICATION · ARCHITECTURE · PROJECT_CONVENTIONS · SECURITY · PERFORMANCE · BUILD · PACKAGE_CHANGE · GENERATED_VENDOR · API_COMPATIBILITY · SEMANTIC_PRESERVATION · DIFF · ROLLBACK
required_fields.notes: one type per record · CI-5-style precision

required_fields.name: state
required_fields.shape: enum · MEASURED · PASSED · FAILED · NOT_MEASURED · NOT_APPLICABLE · INCONCLUSIVE · BLOCKED · STALE
required_fields.notes: constitutional 8-state model · see evidence-state-model

required_fields.name: measurement
required_fields.notes: the deterministic measurement · unit + value must both be present when state=MEASURED/PASSED/FAILED

required_fields.name: value
required_fields.shape: typed value · number or string or boolean or structured
required_fields.notes: the observed value · absent when state ∈ {NOT_MEASURED, NOT_APPLICABLE, BLOCKED}

required_fields.name: baseline_value
required_fields.shape: same type as value or null
required_fields.notes: the pre-candidate baseline for delta computation

required_fields.name: candidate_value
required_fields.shape: same type as value or null
required_fields.notes: the post-candidate value

required_fields.name: delta
required_fields.notes: delta computed deterministically · never inferred qualitatively

required_fields.name: methodology
required_fields.shape: string · describes how the measurement was produced
required_fields.notes: reproducibility discipline · e.g. 'ran vitest with --reporter=json'

required_fields.name: tool
required_fields.notes: which tool measured it

required_fields.name: tool_version
required_fields.notes: measurement is not reproducible without tool version

required_fields.name: timestamp
required_fields.notes: recorded at measurement · never edited

required_fields.name: source_files
required_fields.notes: which files the measurement inspected

required_fields.name: source_hashes
required_fields.notes: hashes recorded so re-measurement can detect drift

required_fields.name: reproducibility_information
required_fields.notes: exact command to reproduce · with env fingerprint

required_fields.name: limitations
required_fields.shape: string · what this measurement does NOT establish
required_fields.notes: mandatory · every measurement has scope limits

required_fields.name: provenance
required_fields.notes: attribution ledger link · never anonymous · see provenance-model

required_fields.name: confidence
required_fields.notes: measurement confidence · not decision confidence

required_fields.name: attribution
required_fields.notes: external_llm_used=false · deterministic=true · taught_by=master_ai_engineer

hard_invariants: state=NOT_MEASURED · MUST NOT be promoted to PASSED downstream
state=UNKNOWN or missing · treated as NOT_MEASURED · never as PASSED
state=STALE when source_hashes have changed since timestamp
measurement.value MUST be present when state ∈ {MEASURED, PASSED, FAILED}
baseline_value MUST be present when evaluating a candidate against existing code
every measurement records tool + tool_version + reproducibility_information
evidence_id is monotonic and never re-used
attribution.external_llm_used MUST be false · attribution.deterministic MUST be true
